title: Valve warns Steam Machine and Steam Controller buyers of possible data breach after cyberattack
summary: The attack on logistics partner CEVA Logistics may have exposed personal information of European users of Steam hardware, prompting the company to ask users to be wary of suspicious messages.

title: Big Walk surpasses one million copies sold and becomes a bigger hit than Untitled Goose Game
summary: House House's cooperative title reaches a sales milestone in less than a week and surprises the industry.

title: Marvel Tōkon receives its first PC patch to fix serious performance issues
summary: Arc System Works begins repairing the Steam version, which suffered frame drops and technical annoyances, and players expect more fixes.

title: Cloud version of Aliens: Fireteam Elite disappears on Nintendo Switch and becomes unplayable
summary: Those who paid for the game lose access without a clear refund, reopening the debate about the future of digital games.

title: Player gets Steam refund after 470 hours in Battlefield 6 due to removal of a mode
summary: Valve agreed to refund $109 after the game removed a popular mode, while developers look for ways to restore it.

title: 1666: Amsterdam, the witch game from the creator of Assassin's Creed, will enter early access on August 25
summary: Early impressions highlight its ambitious semi-open world and original ideas, though they also note it still needs polish.

title: No Man's Sky celebrates its tenth anniversary with new surprises and a promising future
summary: Sean Murray reviews the game's evolution and Hello Games confirms the adventure continues, while players have barely explored 1% of the planets.

title: Halloween: The Game banned in Australia and New Zealand for depicting drug use
summary: The decision reignites the debate over drug-related censorship versus explicit violence, and some GTA 6 fans fear similar restrictions.

title: Blizzard is Xbox's best-performing studio, according to leaked emails
summary: The success of Diablo 4 and Overwatch places Blizzard as the strongest company within Microsoft's portfolio of studios.

title: The Division Resurgence arrives on Steam and receives harsh criticism over microtransactions and poor interface
summary: The free-to-play spin-off of The Division, designed for mobile, confuses PC players with its business model and usability.

title: Brand New Day boosts Marvel's Spider-Man 2 sales and paves the way for Spider-Man 5
summary: The new content for Marvel's Spider-Man 2 has given a notable commercial boost, and Sony is already thinking about the next installment, though it won't be immediate.

title: Over the Hill, the off-road game from the creators of Art of Rally, will arrive on October 14
summary: The title, with over one million wishlists on Steam, will release first on PC and come to consoles in 2027.

title: Take-Two offers new details on GTA 6: no pre-order numbers, online mode will take time, and promotion will include Netflix
summary: Take-Two's CEO defends not revealing pre-orders to avoid misunderstandings, says multiplayer will still require waiting, and that Rockstar is seeking new approaches.

title: id Software developer criticizes Microsoft for layoffs and for 'not understanding art'
summary: The statements assert that the massive cuts and the company's lack of sensitivity weaken the industry and the care for games.

title: Sean Murray reveals Light No Fire is fairly advanced and will have long-term support
summary: The creator of No Man's Sky explains why he changed his mind about a bigger announcement and what to expect from Hello Games' next game.

title: Overwatch overhauls its battle pass and brings back old passes permanently
summary: Players will be able to redeem unwanted skins and access rewards from previous seasons starting next month.

title: 50 Cent will produce a Payday project for television or film
summary: The rapper joins as executive producer on the audiovisual adaptation of the heist franchise.

title: Square Enix starts fiscal year with 88% profit increase
summary: Strong financial results ease dependence on Final Fantasy XIV and point to a good time for the publisher.

title: Persona boss says remakes of Persona 1 and 2 are something 'we have to do'
summary: The executive acknowledges that the first titles in the series are the most forgotten and hopes to remake them in the future.

title: Fan group creates complete 2D demake of Metroid Prime
summary: The project, developed in secret for three years, reinterprets the adventure with a classic aesthetic and is now playable.

title: Xbox will require age verification in Australia to access 18+ games at the end of August
summary: The new measure will apply on console and PC and will not affect games users already own.

title: GameStop and Ryan Cohen weigh not buying a company that isn't for sale
summary: eBay's rejection and lack of funds lead GameStop to reconsider a $56 billion acquisition.
